# flutter_quill

**Tag**: editor, text, rich-text-editor, quill, flutter-quill, web, mobile, desktop, ui

## 简介

A rich text editor built for Android, iOS, Web, and desktop platforms. It's the WYSIWYG editor and a Quill component for Flutter.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/singerdmx/flutter-quill/
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/singerdmx/flutter-quill/issues/
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_quill
